signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office

roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Shorter time to first meal and increased NPS during trial experience
Faster learning through rigorous experimentation and scalable experimentation infrastructure
Set and drive the product vision and roadmap across Home Screen, Search, Menu, Swimlanes, Collections, Product Tile & Detail, Cart & Checkout, and Core UI Components.
Define a coherent discovery experience across web and mobile that scales with catalog complexity and evolving user needs.
Manage a large, diverse surface area with competing priorities without losing coherence or momentum.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Strategic Partnerships
roles.location: New York, New York, United States; United States (Remote)

bullets: Define the launch strategy for each new partnership — messaging, activation plan, launch milestones, and success metrics
Work with marketing and brand partners on co-branded campaigns, member communications, and channel activation
Set and track launch KPIs; run post-launch reviews to identify what’s working and what to iterate on
Build partnership launch playbooks that make each new partner go-live smoother and faster than the last
